prompt: Rank the scraped jobs and show me the best matches
assertions: Runs a Python script that reads jobs_raw_*.json from the job-scraper output directory
Calls the Claude API (anthropic SDK) to score each job
Uses the candidate profile from references/profile.md in the scoring prompt
Prints a summary including total evaluated, passed count, and top 5 matches

prompt: Score the jobs from today's scrape. Only show me ones that are 70% or better matches
assertions: Uses threshold 0.70 instead of the default 0.60
Outputs a ranked JSON with threshold field set to 0.70
Prints the count of jobs passing the 70% threshold

prompt: Which jobs match my background? I want to see the full ranked list
assertions: Scores all jobs in the raw file
Includes match_reasons and match_gaps fields in each job entry
Jobs are sorted by match_score from highest to lowest
